tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh standalone original blink of the exact adopted Darwin's fox attached as sole direct identity/style/exact standing-body reference, not an edit target. Draw ONLY ONE complete same character on the original1254x1254transparent canvas with exactly the same figure placement, visible size and standing silhouette as the reference. All head/face/chin/shoulder/torso and foot distances must remain the same: native reference landmarks are ear tips124, main head top227, nose520, chin/neck724, paired feet1179. Change ONLY both eyes to two soft closed-eye curved lines. Keep original muzzle/nose/mouth/whiskers or fur details and arm/tail posture unchanged. Do not flatten or shorten chin, shorten torso, lower head, enlarge ears or move feet; the previous multi-pose sheet subtly changed those proportions. Keep same warm brown contour, original palette and soft intentional painted paper texture, crisp clean native detail. No new paint lumps/bleeding, highlights, props, effect rays, text, labels, clothing, ground, shadows, extra fingers/limbs/tails, pale palm pads or other elements. Genuine transparent background and full unclipped subject margins. Sole visual change is eye closure, body is the fixed normal posture.
